device_entry.name: 罗德与施瓦茨 ZNB20 矢量网络分析仪
device_entry.name_en: Rohde & Schwarz ZNB20 Vector Network Analyzer
device_entry.description: 用于对微波器件和射频网络进行扫频测试的矢量网络分析仪，可读取扫频频率点以及复数或格式化的测量数据，常用于 S 参数表征。
device_entry.description_en: A vector network analyzer for swept-frequency testing of microwave devices and RF networks. It can read sweep stimulus points and complex or formatted measurement data, and is commonly used for S-parameter characterization.
